Rights Work Agency Blog Process FAQ

Creators

Apply to create for hypjam.

It takes about four minutes. Tell us where to find you, what you make and one thing you are proud of. There is no follower minimum and no showreel to build, and a person reads every application.

About you

First and last is fine.

We reply here. Nothing else goes to this address.

Some briefs need creators in a particular place.

Your username, not your display name. Leave it blank if you do not use Discord.

Your socials

Add every account you have. An @handle or a link both work. Skip any you do not use; we need at least one.

One per line: Lemon8, a link-in-bio page, a UGC marketplace profile, anything else.

There is no minimum. This only helps us match briefs.

Your work
Have you made UGC for a brand before?

Either answer is fine. We cast on fit, not on a track record.

One per line: posts, a portfolio, a Drive folder, whatever shows the work.

Everyone answers this, experienced or not. A post you filmed, a video you edited, or something you made to show what you can do. Paste a public link from TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Drive or Dropbox.

What kind of videos do you make?

Pick any that apply.

Which niches do you know best?

Pick any that apply.

What do you film with? Optional

Pick any that apply. A phone is all most briefs need.

When can you usually film? Optional

A rough figure is fine. We always agree the rate with you before you film.

Last thing

It helps us know where to keep looking.

Languages you can film in, products you will not promote, places you can shoot.

We can only work with adult creators.

Applying does not guarantee work; it puts you on the list we cast from. What you send is covered by our privacy policy.

Open the email again

What happens next.

  1. A person reads it. Not a filter, not a score.
  2. If you fit a brief we are casting, we email you with the brief, the rate and the usage before you agree to anything.
  3. If you do not hear back straight away it means nothing fits yet. We keep applications for up to two years and come back to them.
